17/S0.subgoal: Recap previous tracking concepts and describe the IMU sensor's components and roles in the tracking process.

17/S1.subgoal: Explain the calibration stage of the tracking process by mathematically mapping cheap sensor data to accurate benchmark data.

17/S2.subgoal: Describe the registration and integration stages for establishing the initial orientation and computing pose over time.

17/S3.subgoal: Explain how the drift correction stage blends data from multiple sensors to minimize estimation errors.

17/S4.subgoal: Summarize the four stages of the tracking process and provide a preview of the next topic.
